basis: 2026-11-12 user device declarations and root clarified contracts; actual new UI/server integration not frozen

cases.name: default_present_is_declaration_only
cases.acceptance: Fresh isolated profile: all devices declared present; getUserMedia/getDisplayMedia call counts0; UI states distinguish detection/OS permission/activity.

cases.name: microphone_absent_preserves_tts
cases.acceptance: Start actual MediaRecorder from fixed test WAV, select microphone absent, tracks end; typing and actual test-tone TTS still work.

cases.name: camera_absent_does_not_deny_screen
cases.acceptance: Camera absent removes camera/gaze capability only; independently consented screen sharing remains available. No claim of physical camera/eye tracking.

cases.name: auxiliary_display_absent_preserves_pc
cases.acceptance: Display refers to optional5-inch device; absent leaves PC character, PCVision choice and ordinary desktop operation available.

cases.name: declaring_present_again_never_resumes
cases.acceptance: Change absent to present: no automatic media/session start; explicit user action is required; persisted browser permission may be reused by browser, not forcibly re-prompted.

cases.name: role_hide_close_cancel_scoped_activity
cases.acceptance: Role/appearance change, native hide and privacy-layer close stop the appropriate tracks/session and reject late results.

cases.name: denied_permission_is_not_connected
cases.acceptance: Deny synthetic permission request: helpful error and inactive state; no connected claim and no cloud fallback.

cases.name: unconfigured_vision_never_collects
cases.acceptance: Vision provider unavailable leaves camera/screen unstarted and explicitly unavailable; current text Qwen is not a VLM.

cases.name: preview_is_not_share
cases.acceptance: Explicit camera/screen source preview creates no frame inference request until single-frame consent and share action.

cases.name: single_frame_not_background_capture
cases.acceptance: One user share yields one bounded frame; no continuing frame uploads after waiting; stop/role change invalidates server observation.

cases.name: close_frees_tracks_and_session
cases.acceptance: Closing source flow releases real tracks; if a server session exists, stop route is called with original bound scope.

cases.name: missing_device_is_not_missing_all_inputs
cases.acceptance: Microphone, camera and auxiliary display settings are independent; absence cannot silently disable unrelated inputs/output.

scope_limits: Synthetic Chrome media sources and controlled VLM/ASR only, clearly labelled
Native Linux Electron source smoke uses attached backend, not bundled backend spawn
No account connection or actual outbound platform action
interpretation: Only completed local behaviors are verified; default declarations and synthetic Chrome media do not establish physical devices, real VLM, native chooser or Windows permission results.
